owner_creation.analysis: thisfile: The private pointer selects the active ifile-owned filestate; ch_init either borrows an existing state or allocates and attaches a new one.
owner_creation.invariant: Active selection is an alias of an ifile-owned state.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.

aliases_escapes.analysis: thisfile: ch_get and navigation functions retain raw state/list/hash pointers across native reads and diagnostics; the pointer carries no generation or borrow lifetime.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Active-state aliases must not outlive the attached ifile.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.

callback_targets.analysis: thisfile: Direct input, display and close/disposal calls can cross module boundaries while the active pointer is live; no callback slot mediates its lifetime.
callback_targets.invariant: Cross-owner calls require explicit filestate stability.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.

invalidation.analysis: thisfile: dispose_ifile_state clears the ifile attachment and thisfile alias before freeing nodes/state; ch_close may retain a nonseekable state for later navigation.
invalidation.invariant: Navigation retention and permanent deletion are different lifetimes.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.

mutation_commit.analysis: thisfile: ch_init initializes list/hash metadata before attaching a new state; close/free paths still mutate raw globals without an owning transaction guard.
mutation_commit.invariant: A published active pointer must describe initialized lists.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.

release_pair.analysis: thisfile: Ordinary owned FDs close once; CH_KEEPOPEN stdin and pipe/help owners are excluded. Disposal frees all cached buffers and state on permanent deletion.
release_pair.invariant: Borrowed stdin must not be closed by cache disposal.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.

error_cleanup.analysis: thisfile: First-buffer failure now stops before sentinel dereference; other fatal or asynchronous cleanup can still revisit raw state during partial mutation.
error_cleanup.invariant: A local guard does not certify every cleanup entry.
limitations: The current stdin cleanup fix is preserved; IND-MEM-STDIN-DELETE remains open and requires independent maintained gate disposition.
